name: Sakura Ayumi
source:
A natural airhead who gives off a fluffy, dreamy vibe and speaks with a
childish lisp. With her kindness toward everyone without discrimination
and her plump, voluptuous body, she is hailed as the angel of the
academy and has the boys captivated.
She has shone as the number-one girl the guys at school want as their
girlfriend, and has been scouted many times to see if she would debut
in the entertainment industry as an airhead-type idol.

She has a contrasting innocent face and plump body. She has an adorable personality that makes her popular with men and women alike. She often misleads boys into believing she is interested in them due to her clueless personality. She rejects most confessions since she sees boys as her friends.
